# Load libraries
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(GGally)

# Get historical Tesla stock prices (monthly)
tsla <- tq_get(
  "TSLA",
  get = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    mutate_fun = to.period,
    period = "months"
  )

# Plot Tesla's historical stock price
ggplot(tsla, aes(x = date, y = close)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Tesla (TSLA) Stock Price History",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Closing Price ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Get Tesla monthly returns
tsla_returns <- tq_get(
  "TSLA",
  get = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period = "monthly",
    col_rename = "monthly_return"
  )
# Plot Tesla monthly returns
ggplot(tsla_returns, aes(x = date, y = monthly_return)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Tesla (TSLA) Monthly Returns",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Monthly Return"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(GGally)
# Define tickers
tickers <- c("AAPL", "TSLA", "META", "NVDA", "GOOG")

# Get monthly returns for all stocks
returns_data <- tq_get(
  tickers,
  get  = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select     = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period     = "monthly",
    col_rename = "monthly_return"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = symbol,
    values_from = monthly_return
  )

# Remove rows with missing data (e.g., if any stock has shorter history)
returns_data_clean <- na.omit(returns_data)

# Correlation scatterplot matrix (visual)
ggpairs(
  returns_data_clean[, -1],  # exclude date column
  title = "Monthly Return Correlation Matrix: AAPL, TSLA, META, NVDA, GOOG"
)

# Optional: print the correlation matrix (numbers)
cor_matrix <- cor(returns_data_clean[, -1])
print(round(cor_matrix, 3))

library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
# Get Tesla monthly returns
tsla_returns <- tq_get(
  "TSLA",
  get = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period = "monthly",
    col_rename = "monthly_return"
  )
# Risk-free rate
rf_annual  <- 0.0432
rf_monthly <- rf_annual / 12
# Calculate excess returns
tsla_returns <- tsla_returns %>%
  mutate(excess_return = monthly_return - rf_monthly)

# Sharpe Ratio
sharpe_ratio_tsla <- mean(tsla_returns$excess_return, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sd(tsla_returns$monthly_return, na.rm = TRUE)

# Print result
print(paste("Tesla Sharpe Ratio:", round(sharpe_ratio_tsla, 3)))

library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
# Tesla monthly returns
tsla <- tq_get(
  "TSLA",
  get = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period = "monthly",
    col_rename = "tsla_return"
  )
# S&P 500 monthly returns
sp500 <- tq_get(
  "^GSPC",
  get = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period = "monthly",
    col_rename = "market_return"
  )
# Join Tesla and market returns by date
returns <- left_join(tsla, sp500, by = "date")
# Risk-free rate
rf_annual  <- 0.0432
rf_monthly <- rf_annual / 12
returns <- returns %>%
  mutate(
    excess_tsla   = tsla_return - rf_monthly,
    excess_market = market_return - rf_monthly
  )
# CAPM regression
capm_model <- lm(excess_tsla ~ excess_market, data = returns)

# Extract alpha and beta
alpha <- coef(capm_model)[1]
beta  <- coef(capm_model)[2]

# Print monthly results
print(paste("Beta:", round(beta, 3)))
print(paste("Jensen’s Alpha (monthly):", round(alpha, 5)))
# Annualized Jensen's Alpha
alpha_annualized <- (1 + alpha)^12 - 1

print(paste("Jensen’s Alpha (annualized):", round(alpha_annualized, 4)))

library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(quadprog)
tickers <- c("AAPL", "TSLA", "META", "NVDA", "GOOG")
returns_data <- tq_get(
  tickers,
  get  = "stock.prices",
  from = "2010-01-01"
) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  tq_transmute(
    select     = adjusted,
    mutate_fun = periodReturn,
    period     = "monthly",
    col_rename = "monthly_return"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = symbol,
    values_from = monthly_return
  )

# Remove missing rows
returns_data_clean <- na.omit(returns_data)
# Remove date column
portfolio_returns <- returns_data_clean %>%
  select(-date)

# Convert to matrix
R <- as.matrix(portfolio_returns)

# Mean returns and covariance matrix (monthly)
mu    <- colMeans(R)
Sigma <- cov(R)
rf_annual  <- 0.0432
rf_monthly <- rf_annual / 12
rf <- rf_monthly
neg_sharpe <- function(w, mu, Sigma, rf) {
  w <- w / sum(w)  # enforce weights sum to 1
  port_return <- sum(w * mu)
  port_sd     <- sqrt(t(w) %*% Sigma %*% w)
  - (port_return - rf) / port_sd
}
# Initial guess: equal weights
n_assets <- ncol(R)
w0 <- rep(1 / n_assets, n_assets)

# Optimization
opt <- optim(
  par     = w0,
  fn      = neg_sharpe,
  mu      = mu,
  Sigma  = Sigma,
  rf      = rf,
  method  = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower   = rep(0, n_assets),
  upper   = rep(1, n_assets)
)
weights <- opt$par / sum(opt$par)
names(weights) <- colnames(R)
# Total portfolio amount
total_amount <- 100000

# Convert portfolio weights into dollar amounts
dollar_amounts <- round(weights * total_amount, 2)

# Correct possible rounding difference so total equals exactly $100,000
dollar_amounts[length(dollar_amounts)] <-
  total_amount - sum(dollar_amounts[-length(dollar_amounts)])

# Create allocation table
allocation_table <- data.frame(
  Stock = names(weights),
  Weight = round(weights, 4),
  Percentage = round(weights * 100, 2),
  Dollar_Amount = dollar_amounts
)

print(allocation_table)
cat("\nTotal Investment: $", sum(allocation_table$Dollar_Amount))

print("Optimal Portfolio Weights (Max Sharpe Ratio):")
round(weights, 4)
# Portfolio expected return
portfolio_return <- sum(weights * mu)

# Portfolio volatility
portfolio_sd <- sqrt(t(weights) %*% Sigma %*% weights)

# Portfolio Sharpe ratio
portfolio_sharpe <- (portfolio_return - rf) / portfolio_sd

cat("\nPortfolio Expected Monthly Return:", round(portfolio_return, 4))
cat("\nPortfolio Monthly Volatility:", round(portfolio_sd, 4))
cat("\nPortfolio Sharpe Ratio:", round(portfolio_sharpe, 4))
